name: ai-skills
description: A marketplace of Agent Skill plugins for application development: clean code, code review, epic planning, devops, and issue delivery.

plugins.name: clean-code
plugins.description: Stack-aware clean-code best practices. Detects the project's framework and version, then loads only the matching guidance across frontend, backend, and shared core standards.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Source-agnostic first-pass code review across parallel dimensions, reported as Conventional Comments. Works on a local diff, a branch, or a GitHub or GitLab pull or merge request. Never approves or merges.

plugins.name: epic-planning
plugins.description: Turn a feature idea into a complete epic and its stories through a challenge-driven conversation, then create them with their relations and metadata on GitHub, Jira, or Trello. Never creates anything without approval.

plugins.name: devops
plugins.description: Production best practices for deploying to Kubernetes and OpenShift. Detects the platform, then loads only the matching manifest guidance: resources, probes, security context, rollout, RBAC, and high availability.

plugins.name: issue-delivery
plugins.description: Take an issue from a tracker to an open pull request: fetch, branch, analyse, implement to the project's standards, test, open the PR, and update the board on GitHub, GitLab, or Jira. Delegates coding, git, and review to the other skills. Never merges.
